Resolve criteria-number gap and omitted Intel NIC checks
Review all adapters and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Adds serial/PCIe/port traceability, rejects the invented one-sensor shortcut and exposes the twenty-four-number criteria gap.
independent_technical_reasoning: Multiple Intel NICs can share labels while occupying different slots, firmware revisions and thermal environments. Evidence must bind each record to serial/BDF/port so one adapter cannot satisfy another. Link and workload context explain temperature without introducing active stress. The source does not authorize assuming TEMP_INTEL_NIC is complete or reconstructing criteria 3–26.
